jobs.title: Transportation Engineering Director
jobs.description:
What Your Day Will Look Like:

As a civil engineering transportation director, you`ll be oversee the planning, design, and maintenance of a public or private organization's transportation infrastructure programs, such as roads, bridges, and transit systems. You`ll manage staff and budgets, develop capital improvement plans, ensure projects meet standards, collaborate with stakeholders, and handle business development and client relations.

What You'll Do:

Direct a team of engineers and technical staff, conducting performance evaluations, and managing budgets and departmental operations.
Develop and implement long-term plans for transportation systems, including capital improvement plans.
Oversee the design and delivery of complex transportation projects to ensure they are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
Provide technical guidance and act as the expert on transportation engineering principles, traffic control, and public roadway regulations.
Collaborate with external partners such as government agencies, metropolitan planning organizations, and community groups.
Lead efforts to secure new projects, develop proposals, and negotiate contracts, especially in the private sector.

What You'll Need:

Bachelor of Science in Civil or Structural Engineering.
Minimum Fifteen years of transportation engineering experience.
Professional Engineer (PE) license.
Proficiency in AutoCAD and Civil3D software.
This hybrid job operates between an office environment and a field environment and routinely requires the use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones and copy machines. May require occasional exposure to work environments that may include inclement weather, heat, humidity, noise, hazard, atmospheric conditions, and bodies of water, depending on project requirements.
While performing the duties of this job, physical demands of the employee include frequent sitting, moving, standing, talking, hearing, and occasional balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, handling, grasping, and feeling. This job may occasionally require operating a company vehicle, and lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling up to 35 lbs.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril's Maritime Division is responsible for planning and executing Anduril's product and revenue roadmap for maritime missions. Working across product, engineering, business development, logistics, and operations, the Maritime team develops, tests, deploys, and sustains the Anduril maritime capabilities in a challenging operational environment worldwide. As a leader in the Maritime Division, you must be a technical leader with the expertise to evaluate, qualify, manage, and advocate for an increasing number of sophisticated parallel pursuits. This role is crucial in ensuring that each initiative aligns with the company's strategic direction and receives the appropriate resourcing, balancing innovation with practical execution to drive the business line's success.

About The Job

You will lead the technical development and integration as Chief Engineer
for a maritime product, from initial concept through delivery. You will work closely with program leadership, teams from other Anduril products, and third party system vendors to develop these engineering solutions so that requirements are tied to customer inputs and there is traceability to program office technical decisions.

Your spectrum of support will be diverse in nature and require you to leverage your technical expertise as well as leadership skills to set objectives, build cross-functional teams, and rapidly drive to completion. The ability to leverage your intuition and prior experience will be key in making sure the right design, analysis, and test steps are completed to ensure success. The ideal candidate will leverage their experience executing and successfully completing prior highly optimized multi-disciplinary projects.

What You'll Do

Support early architecture definition and scoping for a new product, defining the technical approach, key requirements, and prototype design
Support the build out of development timelines with associated milestones and staffing needs
Work directly with the product team (Product Manager, EPM, Lead Systems Engineer) to ensure tactical development is executed on plan
Accountable for technical decisions and developments on the AUV
Perform initial system trades and studies on key functions, such as energy storage, vehicle control, volume and mass budget creation, and payload capacity
Lead a new team within Anduril Maritime working on development and prototyping of a new platform; defining key performance parameters and requirements and supporting SRR, PDR, and CDR
Work closely with functional leads to drive common approaches for technical development and process
Responsible for root cause corrective action process as well as case-by-case execution and implementation. Have high ownership over the reliability and lifetime performance of the AUV product and family
Technical point of contact for IRADs on AUV, consulting or delegating as required to appropriate leads
Identify opportunities for Division collaboration and commonality in design and processes
Key stakeholder for technical feasibility/impact in proposed work or capability insertion

Required Qualifications

Deep understanding of ocean-going craft, systems engineering, product development, and overall engineering process
Experience in a senior role leading maritime programs from initial concept through test and delivery to customers
Strong understanding of the "why" behind vehicle and systems design
Experience working on mission-critical DoD systems
Proven history of delivery when presented with open-ended problems, balancing technical analysis with test and validation to move rapidly through new production design
Experience creating teams and focusing them around a common vision, leading by example and embodying high-ownership over the problem and the technical solution
Bachelor's degree in Marine, Mechanical, Electrical or Software engineering, or equivalent experience in a relevant field
Willingness to Travel 25% to customer and test sites
Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

US Salary Range

$253,000—$336,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Build, develop and mentor a high-performing engineering team with clear ownership and accountability.
Foster a culture focused on technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Align closely with global manufacturing engineering teams to ensure efficient product development and successful production launch.

Product Management

Develop and execute the product roadmap in line with business strategy and manufacturing capability.
Manage the existing product portfolio, ensuring complete technical documentation and ongoing product support.
Oversee Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) and Product Change Notices (PCNs) to minimise customer disruption.
Lead product testing and validation programmes to strengthen product performance and market competitiveness.

Deliver custom and modified product designs to meet customer-specific requirements.
Improve speed to design and speed to quotation.

Approve design revisions and first article inspections.
Assess customer requirements against manufacturing capabilities, tooling constraints and commercial considerations.

Quality & Compliance

Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards and regulatory requirements including ISO, IATF 16949, REACH and RoHS.

Drive improvements across engineering, quality and compliance processes.
Improve engineering productivity, resource utilisation and project visibility through best practice methodologies.

Customer Engagement

Ensure close integration between Engineering, Sales, Operations, Manufacturing and Supply Chain to improve execution speed and business performance.

Ensure engineering capability supports long-term growth, innovation and market expansion.

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. An advanced engineering qualification is desirable.

Proven experience leading engineering teams within a manufacturing environment.
Strong customer-facing engineering experience.
Extensive knowledge of connector design, product development and manufacturing processes.
Experience with APQP, PPAP and IATF 16949 methodologies.
Strong understanding of injection moulding, metal stamping and related manufacturing processes.

Strategic thinker with strong commercial awareness.

Working knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, observability, SLOs, secure SDLC, and cloud-native operational practices.
Experience developing engineers and technical leads with a track record of growing individuals into broader technical and leadership responsibilities.
Demonstrated ability to build collaborative engineering teams and foster a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and direct cross-functional communication.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions, navigate ambiguity, and build trusted partnerships across groups.

You will lead teams building AI-driven services, autonomous workflows, distributed systems, and platforms that connect cloud intelligence with edge devices operating in real-world environments.

You will work closely with Product, Architecture, AI/ML, Edge, and Platform teams to transform large-scale streams of sensor and video data into actionable intelligence. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.
Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.

Cross-functional Leadership: Partner closely with Product, Hardware, Security, Infrastructure, and Architecture organizations to align priorities and accelerate delivery.

Strategic Thinking: Ability to make thoughtful, data-driven decisions and balance long-term platform investments with immediate business needs.

Experience with Computer Vision, Large Vision Models, or multimodal systems.
Experience deploying AI models to edge environments including NVIDIA Jetson or similar hardware.
Experience with AI frameworks and tooling including TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangGraph, MCP frameworks, vector databases, and inference platforms.

We are seeking a skilled and visionary Data Engineering Director to lead a dynamic team responsible for driving our data development initiatives as we transition from on-premises infrastructure and legacy cloud environments to Azure Databricks as the target enterprise data platform. This pivotal role will oversee the strategy, design, and execution of scalable lakehouse architectures, secure data ingestion patterns, and high-performing data pipelines using Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Azure Data Lake Storage, and related Azure services. The purpose of this position is to champion the modernization of our data ecosystem, enabling advanced analytics, AI/ML readiness, real-time insights, stronger governance, and operational efficiency on the Azure platform. Reporting directly to senior leadership, the Data Engineering Director will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver a future-ready data platform that powers innovation, regulatory compliance, and business growth. This position will oversee our Data Engineering operations for GBS Bogota serving IB.

Accountabilities

Strategic Leadership: Define and execute the data engineering roadmap for migrating on-premises data systems to the cloud, aligning with organizational objectives and timelines.
Team Management: Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of data engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
Azure Databricks Migration Oversight: Oversee the end-to-end migration of data pipelines, data stores, and analytical workloads from on-premises and legacy platforms to Azure Databricks, ensuring secure, scalable, and cost-effective delivery.
Lakehouse Architecture Design: Design and implement robust, scalable, and secure lakehouse architectures on Azure Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, medallion architecture patterns, and integration with Azure Data Lake Storage and downstream analytics platforms.
Data Pipeline Development: Direct the creation and optimization of ETL/ELT, batch, streaming, and incremental data pipelines using Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, SQL, Python/PySpark, and orchestration capabilities across Azure and Databricks workflows.
Collaboration: Partner with data scientists, analysts, IT teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver tailored data solutions.
Quality, Governance, and Security: Establish and enforce best practices for data governance, quality, security, lineage, access controls, encryption, compliance, and auditability using Unity Catalog, Azure security controls, and enterprise data management standards.
Technology Evaluation: Assess and recommend Azure-native and Databricks-native capabilities, including Lakeflow, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Azure Data Factory, Azure Monitor, CI/CD tooling, and DevOps automation to enhance data processing, storage, governance, and accessibility.
Performance Monitoring: Implement monitoring, optimization, and cost-management strategies for Azure Databricks workloads, including cluster/serverless compute selection, Spark job tuning, pipeline observability, SLA tracking, and incident response.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience

Optimize these systems for latency, throughput, and cost (caching, routing, distillation, quantization).

You Have

12+ years of engineering experience, including ownership of large-scale, long-lived platforms.
Deep, hands-on experience building LLM-powered and agentic systems in production, beyond chat-based interfaces.
Strong systems and software engineering skills, with the ability to design the architecture and write the code.
